results.content: Approval of Trump’s handling of his job varies dramatically in line with the news sources to which people turn, due to both the content and the self-selected audience of each news organization. The audience of Newsmax gives the president an 85% job approval rating, followed by the Fox News audience at 68% approval. Among those who get news from podcasts, 58% approve of Trump. results.title: Marquette Law School Poll, National survey, July 22-29, 2026

results.content:
Trump’s approval rating stands at 34%, while 64% of Americans say they disapprove of his job performance – unchanged since April. About seven-in-ten Republicans (69%) currently approve of his performance, while roughly three-in-ten (29%) disapprove. Democrats continue to overwhelmingly disapprove of his performance (93% disapprove, 6% approve).

Registered voters are more likely to say they'll vote for Democrats than Republicans in this fall's congressional elections by a margin of 4 percentage points, according to the latest Economist / YouGov Poll. That's in line with the consistent single-digit leads for Democrats — usually low single digits — that Economist / YouGov surveys have found among registered voters over the past year.
